subject: Pricing & discount follow-up — committed-use / startup program
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Turner <emma@saasco.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — pricing & token volumes

Hi Emma — great to chat earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same page and can move to a proposal: 

- Primary use: customer-facing summarization + search re-ranking (mix of completion + embeddings).
- Current target: pilot in Q3, goal to scale in months 4–6 after pilot.
- Key constraints: 1) predictable unit cost, 2) tight latency for inference, 3) security/compliance (SaaSCo will need SOC 2 + audit log details).

Couple of ask items so we can size a committed-use proposal: 
1) Rough monthly token volume range (avg and peak).
2) Target unit economics — you mentioned a target $/1M tokens number on the call; can you confirm range?
3) Budget guidance (monthly or annual).

Based on the call I put a quick example in my head: if you land ~50M tokens/month, a target of ~$350–400 per 1M tokens would put you right around the $15–20k/month neighborhood. We can do committed discounts and multi-year incentives to bring the unit price down materially.

If you can reply with the volume and target $/1M tokens, I’ll loop in my manager to draft committed-use options and any startup program credits you may be eligible for.

Next steps: you send volumes + target price/budget -> I’ll propose 1) no-commit hosted, 2) 12mo committed tier, 3) 24mo multi-year option with startup add-on (if eligible).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
From: Emma Turner <emma@saasco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — pricing & token volumes

Thanks Ben — quick answers below. Helpful call.

- Expected starting volume: ~50M tokens/month during pilot (month 1–3).
- Expected steady state (12 months out): 150–200M tokens/month if adoption goes well.
- Target unit economics: we’re aiming for ~$350–400 per 1M tokens (to fit into our current roadmap budget).
- Budget: pilot budget is roughly $15–25k/month; if we can lock a committed discount we could stretch to higher commits.

Two additional asks: 1) Does Redwood have a formal startup program? We’re a seed-stage company (YC S21) so any credits would help. 2) How do committed discounts scale — do you do flat % off list or stepped tiers?

CCing our finance lead on future threads if we move to a quote: Olivia Grant (olivia@saasco.com).

—Emma
Emma Turner

Date: 2026-06-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — pricing & token volumes

Thanks Emma — super helpful. Looping in Marissa (VP Sales) to propose committed tiers and confirm startup eligibility.

Marissa — quick context: SaaSCo (seed, YC S21) is planning a 50M/month pilot, growing to 150–200M/month. Target unit price ~$350–400 per 1M tokens, pilot budget ~15–25k/month. They asked about a formal startup program + how committed discounts scale.

If it helps, I sketched a sample no-commit cost for 50M/month: 50 * $350 = $17,500/month (at $350/1M). They asked whether we can get below $15k/month with commitments or startup credits. Attaching a preliminary quote stub — final numbers to come after you confirm tiers.

Attachment: redwood-quote-20260614.pdf (quote stub)

Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Turner <emma@saasco.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — pricing & token volumes

Hi Emma — thanks for the detail and thanks Ben for the intro. Quick note on options we can offer and an example calc based on the 50M/month pilot: 

1) Startup program: we have a standard early-stage startup package (eligible companies get a 20% credit on first-year usage + onboarding credits). We’ll need basic validation (incorporation docs, YC demo day note was helpful). If eligible we can apply credits to months 1–12.

2) Committed-use pricing (12-month): we typically offer tiered % discounts off list depending on commit level. Example (list = $350/1M): 
   - 12mo, 50M/month commit (600M/year): ~25% off list -> $262.50 / 1M tokens -> monthly = $13,125 (saves ~$4,375/month vs list).
   - 12mo, 100M/month commit (1.2B/year): ~30% off list -> $245 / 1M -> monthly = $24,500.

3) Multi-year (24mo) incentives: for 24-month commitments we can provide an additional 5%–10% on top of the committed tier depending on invoice cadence and legal terms. E.g., 24mo on the 50M tier could push to ~30% off list -> $245 / 1M -> monthly = $12,250.

4) Flexibility: if you expect big growth, we can structure a step-up schedule (start at 50M/month commit and scale to a higher committed tier at pre-agreed points) — helps with runway while securing better unit economics over time.

Next steps I suggest: 
- Emma/Olivia: confirm whether you want a 12mo 50M commit vs 12mo 100M vs 24mo option and whether you want Redwood to include startup credits in the quote.
- Ben/Marissa: we’ll produce a formal quote + term sheet and DocuSign MSA once they pick a path.

Quick price math so it’s actionable: if your pilot stays at 50M/month and you want to get under $15k/month, the 12mo 50M commit at 25% off (monthly $13,125) hits that target. With startup 20% first-year credit on top, effective first-year cash could be lower (we’ll model that in the quote).

Attachments: startup-discount-terms.pdf (program terms)

Best — Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

2) For accounting we prefer monthly invoices with NET-30. If you can include an option for annual prepay pricing in the quote that would be useful too.

Please send a formal quote + DocuSign MSA and we’ll route to Olivia for approval. Our aim is to close by end of June if terms look reasonable.
